SDOJ-Recomp（eandis）安装说明

1. 打开 eandis 的官方发布页，从 Assets 下载 Windows x64 ZIP。
   https://github.com/eandis/SDOJ-Recomp/releases/latest
   标准 Windows 包的文件名形如 sdoj.recomp.1.51.4.win-amd64.zip。
2. 把 ZIP 里的全部内容解压到本目录，保留包内的目录结构。
   解压后，DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou.exe 应和本说明在同一层。
   DLL 和 tools 文件夹也按压缩包里的位置保留。

Installation

1. Download the Windows x64 ZIP from Assets on eandis's official release page.
   https://github.com/eandis/SDOJ-Recomp/releases/latest
   The standard Windows ZIP is named like sdoj.recomp.1.51.4.win-amd64.zip.
2. Extract the entire ZIP into this folder and keep its directory structure.
   DoDonPachi SaiDaiOuJou.exe should be next to this README.
   Keep the DLLs and tools folder in their original locations.
